subject: Q2 closing guide: numbers squeeze + 15min surge window
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 closing guide: numbers squeeze + 15min surge window

Team —

We’re in the final push for Q2. I need a tight, operational update and a 15-minute "surge" call this morning to lock commits. Goal: identify inflight accounts that can move to Commit with an exec escalation or a simple pricing/contract sign-off today.

Please do the following BEFORE the 10:30AM PT surge window:
- Update SFDC stage to the precise stage (Proposal / Legal / Contracting) and populate 'Commit Likelihood' (Commit / Likely / Best Case).
- Attach a one-line blocker and the exact next action (exec call, PO, legal redline, e-sign).
- Verify ARR math in the attached Q2_commit_squeeze_v3.xlsx (tab: FINAL_PULL) — make any adjustments in-line.
- If you need an SLA/credit exception or discount above standard play, call out the approver and send me a note; I will route.

Surge call agenda (15m):
1) Quick roll (30s per account owner): account, ask, $ impact to commit.
2) Blocker + mitigation (60s): what will unblock?
3) Decision (60s): commit / escalate / push to next week.
4) Ops actions (remaining time): SFDC updates + paperwork owner.

I will host a hard stop at 10:45 and publish a one-line status to FinanceOps. Bring only accounts that are realistic to close today.

Attachments: Q2_commit_squeeze_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), 15m_surge_playbook.pdf (playbook with email templates and exec intro blurbs).

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

-------------------------------
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 closing guide: numbers squeeze + 15min surge window

On Wed, 21 May 2025 at 09:12, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> We’re in the final push for Q2...

I updated SFDC and filled FINAL_PULL for the four accounts I own. Short notes below:
- Acme Corp — ready, Legal has one redline; exec intro required (Sara Patel). New ARR if signed: $420k.
- Zephyr Health — finance PO pending; expect PO by EOD if I get the final invoice. $95k.
- Nova Retail — committed verbally; waiting on e-sign from procurement. $60k.
- Helix Systems — we need a minor SOW change; hold until legal clears. $35k (best case).

I’ll be on the 10:30 surge call. I attached my FINAL_PULL exports to the sheet.

—Grace

-------------------------------
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: FinanceOps <finance-ops@acme.com>, Acme Corp - Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:03:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 closing guide: numbers squeeze + 15min surge window

Thanks Marcus — joined and gave a quick status update for Acme.

Summary from the surge:
- Acme Corp (Sara Patel): Legal redline accepted pending one minor confidentiality clause. Sara confirmed exec intro will happen at 14:00 PT. Action: Marcus to route escalation note for SA approval (I copied FinanceOps).
- Zephyr Health: PO promised; Grace to monitor and confirm when sent.
- Nova Retail: procurement e-sign queued; Neha to nudge.
- Helix Systems: moving to next week; marked as Best Case.

Post-call ops:
- I exported the FINAL_PULL tab and uploaded as Q2_commit_squeeze_v3_FINAL.xlsx to our shared drive (link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/abc123).
- I started a DocuSign envelope for Nova Retail (DocuSign link included in SFDC task).

Next steps:
- Marcus will send an escalation note template to Sara and cc FinanceOps for the Acme approval flow.
- Grace will confirm Zephyr PO and update SFDC by EOD.
- I will track signatures and report final status by 17:30 PT.

Attachments referenced: Q2_commit_squeeze_v3.xlsx (updated export) and 15m_surge_playbook.pdf (call script).

-Neha
